_comment: Public log. PRIVACY RULE: never name a reporter, quote their message, or include a Telegram id. Show that reports get fixed, not who reported them. status: fixed | in progress | planned | wont fix. ⚠ Only list PLANNED items you actually intend to build, and never put a DATE on one — a missed date on a public page is a promise broken in writing.

fixes.what: Added an optional daily reminder. Pick a time and get one short message a day, plus a summary of your week on Sundays. It is off unless you choose a time, it is never more than one message a day, and every reminder carries a one-tap Turn off button.
Added a shareable progress card — your questions answered, accuracy, streak and rank as a single image you can post. Get it with /mycard or from Progress.
Every question now shows which exam and year it came from, for example 'NEET-PG 2023'. Two older sets have no year recorded, so those show the exam alone rather than a guessed year.
Fixed 6 questions where OCR had duplicated one of the options, so the same choice appeared twice. The correct answer was never affected; the repeated option has been removed.
Reorganised the buttons under the message box. They are now grouped into Practice and My Account instead of one long list, so the menu takes up less of the screen while you are reading a question.
My Plan and Help can now be reached from the menu itself, under My Account. Previously you had to already know the command existed to check your own plan or find help.

Subscription payments were not unlocking access. A payment made through the auto-renew plan was not being linked back to the buyer's account, so access stayed locked. Fixed the same day; affected payment refunded in full and access granted.
Added /myplan so anyone can check their own plan, expiry and auto-renew status without asking.
Added UPI QR as a payment option alongside the card/UPI link.

Corrected OCR damage across 780+ questions: glued-together words, Roman numerals misread as lowercase letters (CN Vll to CN VII, Angiotensin ll to II), and stray source-book page references left inside explanations.
Removed one question whose patient age was clearly corrupted. It is out of rotation until it can be checked against the source.
Corrected the advertised question counts to match what the bot actually serves, and stated the number of image questions still held back.
Six questions carry a duplicated answer option. The correct answer is unaffected in every case; the duplicate distractor is being replaced.

planned.what: Restore the ~89 image-based questions currently held back, by re-reading each figure clearly enough to be certain of the answer.
Finish cleaning the remaining OCR damage — a tail of run-together words in explanations. Nothing here affects an answer key; it is readability only.
Deeper NEET-PG and INI-CET coverage. Both are already in the bank and both will keep growing.
Other medical entrance and service exams, starting with UPSC CMS. The aim is one place to practise whichever exam you are sitting.
Video-based questions. If you have material that would suit this, send it through — it genuinely helps.
Move the bot to always-on hosting so it keeps answering during a power cut or network drop at my end.

milestones.why: Right now the bot runs on my own laptop, so it can only answer while that machine is awake. Nothing is ever lost — messages queue and payments are picked up automatically — but you can be left waiting. Moving to a proper server ends that.
milestones.unlocks_when: Subscriptions cover the monthly server cost

milestones.why: Access already unlocks by itself, usually in seconds. Once the bot is on a server with a fixed address, the confirmation is immediate and never depends on my laptop being on.
milestones.unlocks_when: The move to always-on hosting is done

milestones.why: 89 image-based questions are held back because I can't yet read the figure clearly enough to be certain of the answer. I would rather withhold a question than serve one I'm unsure of.
milestones.unlocks_when: Each figure has been re-checked by hand

milestones.why: Both are already in the bank and both keep growing. FMGE is the deepest today; the aim is for all three to feel equally complete.
milestones.unlocks_when: Ongoing — questions are added every week

milestones.goal: Other medical entrance and service exams, starting with UPSC CMS
milestones.why: One place to practise whichever exam you are sitting, rather than a different app for each.
milestones.unlocks_when: The three current exams are where I want them
